mapper.insert:
insert into outbound_order_detail ( id, detail_id, outbound_order_id, material_id, material_batch_id, material_type,material_name,spec_model, unit_of_measure, quantity, outbound_time, operator, remark ) values
( #{item.id}, #{item.detailId}, #{item.outboundOrderId}, #{item.materialId}, #{item.materialBatchId}, #{item.materialType},#{item.materialName}, #{item.specModel}, #{item.unitOfMeasure}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.outboundTime}, #{item.operator}, #{item.remark} )
mapper.select: select ood.detail_id, ood.material_id, ood.material_batch_id, ood.material_type,ood.material_name, ood.spec_model, ood.unit_of_measure, ood.quantity, ood.outbound_time, ood.operator,ood.spec_model, obs.id as split_id, obs.inbound_batch_id, obs.split_quantity, obs.remaining_quantity from outbound_order_detail ood left join outbound_batch_split obs on ood.detail_id = obs.outbound_detail_id where ood.outbound_order_id = #{outboundOrderId} order by ood.created_at, obs.created_at
